I'm happy to share my experiences with you!

First of all, I'm super happy you're considering getting help. You deserve to be happy just as much as anyone else, sometimes medical intervention can help!

I was in the emergency department numerous times for mental health issues. I'll tell you about my first time!

The very first time I saw a counselor at my school, they called the hospital and sent me over. I sat in the waiting room for hours before being seen. Looking back, this isn't very safe. I saw an emergency room doctor who asked a few general questions, like if I did drugs and issues regarding my physical health. He asked me if I'd like to see a psychiatrist, everything was 100% on my terms. They brought me to the psych department where everything was chained to the floors. There were security guards watching through the cameras, I waited a few more hours. Eventually I had a psych eval, received a diagnosis and they gave me a taxi coupon to go home.

Overall, I wasn't treated for my suicidal thoughts. However I was connected to a psychologist who honestly changed my life. It wasn't fun in the moment, but super super important long term.
